subject.title: feat(skills): scan session history for workshop ideas

question: Should OpenClaw ship manual historical session mining as a built-in Skill Workshop capability with the associated Gateway, SQLite provenance, provider-cost, and privacy surface?
rationale: The linked issue is explicitly awaiting product direction, the PR carries the protected `maintainer` label, and the implementation creates a substantial new user-facing workflow rather than repairing established behavior.

options.title: Sponsor and complete the feature
options.body: Approve the bounded manual scan, regenerate native protocol artifacts, and require migration/privacy proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Reduce the initial scope or data surface while retaining proposal-only behavior and a documented path to broader history scanning.

options.title: Decline the core direction
options.body: Close the PR and linked issue if historical transcript mining should not become a built-in Workshop workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and complete the feature
recommendation.body: Approve the bounded manual scan, regenerate native protocol artifacts, and require migration/privacy proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person opened the product request and implementation and has adjacent current-main Gateway/session history, making them the strongest available direction owner.
